messages:
Priya: Heads-up from product: we need a concrete upgrade acceptance path for airgapped customers to finalize Q2 roadmap. The asks are operator-offline, signed bundles, and a verification report sales can attach.
Hank: What does "verification report" include? probe results, signature checks, and a node-level egress audit?
Lena: yes. Ops wants: preflight signature validation, manifest lint, resource quota check; post-apply probes: pod readiness, KV cache warmstart, perf smoke (p50/p95). Also an egress probe that attempts outbound to known endpoints and confirms blocked.
Priya: Legal asked we include customer attestation checkbox and retaining an audit bundle (encrypted) for up to 90 days.
ops-bot: created ticket: ENG-priv-offline-acceptance #6578
Hank: For UX, two modes: operator-assisted apply (recommended) and manual instructions (customer-run). Need CLI examples for both.
Lena: CLI ideas:
```
redwood operator install-offline --bundle /tmp/redwood-bundle.tar.gz --tenant acme --mode operator --attest attest.json
redwood operator verify-bundle --bundle /tmp/redwood-bundle.tar.gz --public-key kms://projects/acme/keys/cosign
```
Priya: Also require a canary option even offline: `--offline-canary tenants=1-3` to apply to subset first. Sales said it's a must for a top-10 prospect.
Hank: Security: cosign with external KMS refs, Rekor optional. Attestation should include build hash, sbom, and a signed list of images digests.
Lena: Ops: verification harness design: lightweight `verify-bundle` script + a probe-runner binary included in bundle that runs post-apply checks and emits a simple JSON summary (success/fail + metrics). For airgap compliance, probe-runner must not perform any DNS lookups to internet hosts.
Priya: Pricing note from finance: extended maintenance windows (>2h) will be billed. Need a short table to include in docs. I'll follow up.
Hank: Implementation timeline proposals:
- prototype verify-bundle + cosign flow (owner: Hank) ETA 10 working days
- probe-runner spec + sample probes (owner: Lena) ETA 5 working days
- customer attestation template + legal sign-off (owner: Priya) ETA 3 working days
ops-bot: private-deploy weekly meeting added: follow-up item "airgap acceptance checklist" Tue 10am
Lena: Test cases to add to acceptance checklist:
- offline install with no outbound egress (network kernel probe)
- zero tenant IP reassignment during upgrade
- key rotation during upgrade doesn't block model decrypt
- smoke inference within baseline +/- 20%
Priya: OK I'll draft the acceptance checklist and paste into the handbook. I'll also sync with sales to get specific customer constraints.
Hank: One more: we should automate preflight gate in CI so bundles can't be published without passing signature + lint.
Priya: Great. Owners aligned. I'll create JIRA tasks and update the roadmap entry. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
